(set-logic QF_LIA)
; Boundary kind: 0 dynamic FFI trampoline, 1 static external call, 2 same-module IR/lto inlined body, 3 compiler builtin/intrinsic.
(declare-const kind Int)
(declare-const boundary_cost Int)
(assert (and (>= kind 0) (<= kind 3)))
(assert (= boundary_cost (ite (= kind 0) 9 (ite (= kind 1) 3 0))))

; Claim A: a dynamic unresolved foreign boundary cannot be zero cost.
(push)
(assert (= kind 0))
(assert (= boundary_cost 0))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; Claim B: a same-module/intrinsic lane can have zero boundary cost.
(push)
(assert (or (= kind 2) (= kind 3)))
(assert (not (= boundary_cost 0)))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; Claim C: if a source-level c call is proven inlineable, the remaining call-boundary cost is zero.
(push)
(assert (= kind 2))
(assert (> boundary_cost 0))
(check-sat)
(pop)
(get-model)
(get-info :all-statistics)
